headline: European Gas Storage Withdrawals Reach 11% as Winter Heating Season Begins
summary: European countries have already withdrawn 11% of the natural gas injected into storage during the summer. Combined with a low starting storage level, the rapid drawdowns intensify winter energy supply concerns.
why: Europe relies heavily on stored natural gas to meet peak heating demand during winter months, making storage levels a critical driver of European energy prices.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Rapid depletion of gas storage increases risk of winter supply shortages, driving up European natural gas benchmark prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Faster-than-expected depletion of natural gas reserves heightens fears of winter energy deficits, driving European benchmark gas futures higher.
